cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Lost in the Process
cards.instruction: Hide your role in the problem by distributing blame across steps, policies, and unnamed procedures.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The birthday invitations failed address verification. I'll prepare the correction run.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You wrote our old address on every one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The archive supplied that address. Please distinguish source data from the copying stage.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You are the archive. Change the address and resend them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Give me a second checker before I resend. We need to close the verification gap; please stop treating a staffing failure as a handwriting problem.
